urlencoded.description:
(Required) 'llm_judge' uses an LLM to score outputs against a prompt; 'hog' runs deterministic Hog code.

* `llm_judge` - LLM as a judge
* `hog` - Hog
(Required) Name of the evaluation.

(Required) Output format. Currently only 'boolean' is supported.

* `boolean` - Boolean (Pass/Fail)
Optional description of what this evaluation checks.
Whether the evaluation runs automatically on new $ai_generation events.
Configuration dict. For 'llm_judge': {prompt}. For 'hog': {source}.
Output config. For 'boolean' output_type: {allows_na} to permit N/A results.
Set to true to soft-delete the evaluation.
